doc: A light region: one side of its line, or the inside (a light source's reach) or outside of its circle. Light undoes the shadow wherever it reaches (GAME_SPEC 9.9).

side.doc: the region: a side of the line, the inside or outside of the circle (auto: left, inside)

when.doc: the flag under which it is active (empty: always), e.g. el:wire:charge, det:plate, door:gate
